items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, with the biggest difference seen in walks of 10 to 19 minutes. If you take certain medications, ask your care team about low sugar before adding walks after meals.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: Try not to eat dinner too late, as sugar tends to rise more after late dinners, with a rise of about 9.2 mg/dL more. You've had 2 scored dinners and none of them started at 8 pm or later, so keep it that way.
